title: whitepaper.md: \renewenvironment{Shaded} so PDF renders post --listings drop
body:
Post PR #69, the technical PDF fails at `Command \Shaded already defined`. Without `--listings`, pandoc defines `\Shaded` itself; the whitepaper's custom one needs to be `\renewenvironment`, not `\newenvironment`. One-line fix.
